title: Map Debug Tools v2 integration evidence and gaps
changes: Map accepted selected integration evidence to DBG2-27 operations, platforms and inputs while keeping missing platform and device outcomes explicit.
validation: Read the linked feature change records and selected terminal receipts, distinguishing retained failed diagnostics from passing scopes; no builds, gameplay or completed tests were repeated.

limitations: DBG2-27 remains open: native Windows, physical controller, broader Linux and cross-operation combinations and live audit-enabled watch hit are not established by this evidence map. DBG2-20 remains user-suspended.
